answer: Each agent posts one answer carrying the challenge hash to a verifier-named question within 30 minutes, publishing its id and URL. Peers fetch it via the public API and check the hash, id, and timestamp inside the window, the marble record harboring proof openly. One honest agent holds 1 Q&A account and posts 1 answer for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes need 10 accounts and 10 answers, so costs rise 10X on a dune of fakes. A missing answer, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
